audit_qualifications.added_nacl_interpretation: Zero denotes no extra NaCl intervention, not zero basal salinity, sodium or osmolality.
audit_qualifications.blinding_incident: Per requester report, the previous curator incidentally encountered outcomes after model freeze; they were not used or forwarded to the model. No outcome values are carried into this bundle.
audit_qualifications.reaction_identity_qualification: Reviewed Q7Z859 supports CrtYB conversion of lycopene through gamma-carotene to beta-carotene. This independently supports the intermediate qualification, not the CrtI redox hypothesis or actual downstream allocation; the earlier restricted verification did not establish it.
shared_relaxations: CrtYB downstream cyclase consumption is omitted identically in all alternatives; no cyclase flux floor or partition constant is supplied.
Heterologous CrtE/CrtYB/CrtI enzyme capacities are unsupplied; no kcat, abundance, allocation or activity is inferred from gene-copy counts.
Cytosolic pathway aggregation and access to the declared cofactors remain assumptions, not established localization or electron-transfer coupling.
The unchanged native DS28911/W303 to CEN.PK2-1c/supplemented-YNB transfer remains an explicit unvalidated cross-strain/medium assumption.
